race.comment: SHE'S AN ARTIST (12) hasn't been that far away in two easier races this time in and brings the right figures to secure a Group 3 win. Strong through the line in a fast run race when second over 1100m at Randwick. Top four contender. SYLPH (18) comes out of the same race as SHE'S AN ARTIST when she wound up strongly first up with a tidy third at Randwick. Stakes place mare ready for the trip and Lloyd retains the ride on the limit. Will be motoring late. GERRINGONG (8) multiple Group placegetter resuming, and now in the Munce stable. Raced without luck over the Queensland winter and looks ready to go with the sharp 1000m trial win. TUILERIES (2) resumes. Can get cover from the sticky gate and fitted with the two trials. Each way. MISS FREELOVE (7) ugly draw and undefeated in three first up runs.
